conditions.description: Except in the case of a Maturity Exception Facility, and except with respect to any Refinancing of Secured Indebtedness, the Refinancing Indebtedness must have a Weighted Average Life to Maturity not less than the remaining Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the Indebtedness/Disqualified Stock/Preferred Stock being Refinanced, or alternatively require no or only nominal cash payments (other than interest) prior to the date 91 days after the Loans' maturity date.

conditions.description: To the extent the Refinancing Indebtedness Refinances (i) Indebtedness subordinated in right of payment to the Loans or any Guarantee thereof, the Refinancing Indebtedness must be subordinated in right of payment to the Loans or the Guarantee at least to the same extent as the Indebtedness being Refinanced, or (ii) Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock, the Refinancing Indebtedness must itself be Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock, respectively.

exceptions.description: Refinancing Indebtedness shall not include Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of a Subsidiary of the Borrowers that is not a Guarantor, where such debt Refinances Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of the Borrowers or a Guarantor.

Refinancing Indebtedness shall not include Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of any Restricted Party that refinances Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of an Unrestricted Subsidiary.

Compiled two independently operative permissions from §6.01(b): clause (13) (Refinancing Indebtedness basket) and clause (14) (acquisition/Investment-financing debt basket, including debt of acquired/merged entities), gated respectively by structural WAL/subordination/exclusion tests and by pro forma Interest Coverage Ratio / Total Leverage Ratio tests.

Clause (13)'s capacity is inherently transaction-variable (tied to the amount of debt actually being refinanced plus permitted fees/premiums/OID), not a fixed dollar figure or metric-based formula, and is represented via TRANSACTION_INPUT_REFERENCE nodes rather than a fabricated static amount.

Clause (14) has no stated dollar cap and is correctly modeled as UNLIMITED_CAPACITY gated by the pro forma ratio tests; the '$1.00 of additional Indebtedness under Section 6.01(a)' alternative tests could not be fully resolved because Section 6.01(a)'s own Interest Coverage Ratio and Total Leverage Ratio basket thresholds were truncated in all available/retrieved evidence (only the First Lien Leverage Ratio secured-debt basket at 2.00:1.00 was visible).
The term 'Guarantee' used in the §6.01(b)(13)(b) subordination condition has no definition anywhere in the supplied document (confirmed unresolved).

Seven sibling eligibility baskets cross-referenced by clause (13) (Sections 6.01(b)(4), (5)(b), (12), (18), (19), (27), (31)) were not retrievable within the evidence budget; they are preserved as explicit dependsOn cross-unit dependencies rather than guessed or dropped, and do not affect clause (13)'s own capacity formula.
